clips.title: The story
paras: The Cask 'n' Anvil is a quiet, unnamed tavern building situated in the bustling heart of the Great Forge in Ironforge. Tucked between local shops, it stands as an open gathering hall featuring tables and hearths without a permanent innkeeper or barkeep on staff.

Positioned between the Thistlefuzz Arcanery and the Ironforge Physician, the Cask 'n' Anvil offers a momentary escape from the deafening clatter of the Great Forge. While most taverns in Ironforge bustle with rowdy patrons and busy barkeeps, this spacious hall remains unstaffed, leaving its tables, chairs, and warm hearth open to weary travelers and wandering smiths looking for a quiet bench to sit upon.
